title: Volvo Seies 5 FH16 Hi-tensile Aluminium FUPS Roadtrain Bullbar #48
description: Volvo FH16 Series 5 Hi-tensile 6 Post Heavy Duty Aluminium Road Train FUPS Bullbar, 76mm tube with 6mm thick wall for maximum cab protection. Radar compatible. Custom driving light mounts and LED indicator repeater/daylight running lights mounted in the external box uprights. Flip over Road Train & Long Vehicle signs on aluminium plate. Lower pipe extensions for maximum headlight protection. Heavy duty hi-tensile aluminium backing plate (save 90kgs compared to steel backing plate) with dual tow pins.
